name: dmengine-startup
description: Mode C startup of the real vendor dmengine with a lab DMCDEVINFO SysV segment: the captured tree/config are rewritten to lab values and the engine must read the tree, accept device info, initialize the FUMO plugin and never see the production address. The checks use notice-level FUMO/SCOMO plugin init and device-info markers; it does not complete a DM session.
